text:
tara_support: heads-up: large customer reporting p95 -> 1.8s (normally 350ms) and p99 spikes to 4s since ~07:10 UTC. They see some 429/503s too. Request ids: req=ac7f3b2a, req=ac7f7d4c. Impacting interactive chat flows.
ashwin_eng-runtime: thanks. Do we have correlating ingress metrics? any admission_control rejects or queue depth climb?
ryan_sre: checking. ingress-admit queue length jumped starting 07:09:12. active_workers for model-gamma pool maxed at 95/96. admission_control.started_rejects increased ~07:11. Looks like workers saturated then backlog built -> head-of-line delay.
tara_support: customer sent curl repro. sample: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-customer
{"model":"gamma-large","input":"hi"}
```
They repro consistently during the window.
maria_ops: is this the batcher backlog we've seen before on long context requests? Any KV cache pressure?
ashwin_eng-runtime: quick look at metrics: batcher.pending_batches spiked, avg sequence length for that tenant was ~1600 tokens due to long system messages + history. That increases GPU time and reduces throughput. Also noticed a recent deployment (approx 07:05) that changed default max_concurrency from 6 -> 4 on the pool. Deploy bot: "deploy-1234 finished by ashwin at 07:05 UTC"
ryan_sre: ok that's suspicious: fewer concurrent model slots + increased per-request compute = pileup. admission_control queueing will push latency up. We should roll back that concurrency change on the affected pool and apply a safety cap for long-context requests.
tara_support: customer needs ETA. Can we patch quickly?
ashwin_eng-runtime: plan: 1) temporarily increase pool concurrency on model-gamma back to 6, 2) enable short-term per-tenant request queue cap (reject > 30 inflight), 3) route that customer's traffic to a smaller model variant (gamma-medium) as fallback for 20m.
maria_ops: i'm on it to contact infra to bump concurrency. Also will create a quick routing rule to prefer gamma-medium for that tenant.
ryan_sre: I'll add a short-lived autoscale rule to bring workers from 96 -> 128 if utilization > 85% for 30s. That should reduce backpressure while infra changes roll out.
ashwin_eng-runtime: repro/debug steps for engineers: 
1) tail logs on ingress: `kubectl logs -f ingress-proxy -l pool=model-gamma`
2) check admission control stats: `curl -s http://adm-control/internal/metrics | jq .` look for `rejects` and `queue_length`
3) inspect batcher backlog: metrics `batcher.pending_batches` and `gpu_busy_seconds` per-worker
4) if reproducing locally, set `REDWOOD_MAX_CONCURRENCY=4` to mimic and test.

Small note: there's an older bug where long-context requests block small ones in the same batcher if batching_policy is sequence-length-agnostic. We should consider sequence-length-aware batching as follow-up.
tara_support: customer replied: thanks, agreed to temporary fallback to gamma-medium while you fix. They asked for patch ETA ~15-25m.
maria_ops: bumped pool concurrency back to 6 at 07:26 UTC (change id bump-179). routing rule applied to prefer gamma-medium for that tenant at 07:28.
deploy-bot: "autoscale-rule-attach applied by ryan_sre at 07:29 UTC"
ryan_sre: after changes p95 dropped to ~420ms, p99 ~900ms within 6m. admission rejects back to baseline. batcher.pending_batches normalized.
ashwin_eng-runtime: follow-ups: - revert the recent default concurrency change and add a canary that watches p95 for 10m before promoting to all pools. - add a short-term mitigation knob: per-tenant max_inflight_requests and model_fallback policy. - investigation ticket: long-context causing starvation for short requests; prioritize sequence-length-aware batching.
tara_support: thanks team. I'll close the customer loop and share rollback/fallback notes. Adding timeline to incident log. :thumbsup:
